HAUTE</div>\n<span class=\"loc-overlay__personen is-handwritten\">Up to 80 people</span>\n</div>\n<div class=\"loc-overlay__description text-size-regular\"><p>High above the rooftops of Zurich, this exclusive club restaurant combines a breathtaking view over the city, Lake Zurich and the Alps with a stylish, relaxed ambience. This unique setting creates the perfect backdrop for unforgettable private and business events. Events are generally open to all guests, provided a HAUTE member is present and hosts the event under their membership. From Monday to Friday, events for up to 50 guests can be held in the separate area. At weekends, the club restaurant is available exclusively for events with up to 80 guests.</p>\n</div>\n<section class=\"loc-overlay__info\">\n<div
